import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns

# Load the dataset
data = pd.read_csv('data/cameras.csv', index_col=False)

# Create a bar chart to visualize the distribution of megapixels across different sensor types
plt.figure(figsize=(10, 6))
sns.barplot(x='sensor_type', y='megapixels', data=data)
plt.title('Distribution of Megapixels Across Different Sensor Types')
plt.xlabel('Sensor Type')
plt.ylabel('Megapixels')
plt.legend(title='Sensor Type')

plt.tight_layout()
